verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Grafana exposing itself as an MCP server (grafana-docs-7, grafana-probe-4) so external AI agents can call Grafana's tools — the opposite direction from the story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers into Grafana so Grafana itself can consume their tools. No evidence shows Grafana acting as an MCP client that ingests and uses tools from arbitrary connected MCP servers.
